spec = load_error_spec("03", "full")
cases = [
    ("exact float64", "float64", 1.00),
    ("rounded 1e-3", "rounded_1e-3", 1.00),
    ("0.98 force scale", "float64", 0.98),
]
for label, precision, force_scale in cases:
    result = summarize_error_run(
        time_step=0.18,
        num_steps=spec.experiment.num_steps,
        mass=spec.system.mass,
        omega=spec.system.omega,
        position0=spec.system.position,
        velocity0=spec.system.velocity,
        precision=precision,
        force_case=label,
        force_scale=force_scale,
    )
    print(
        f"{label}: max |dE/E0|={result.max_abs_relative_energy_error:.3e}, "
        f"RMS position error={result.rms_position_error:.3e}, "
        f"normalized drift={result.normalized_energy_drift:.3e}"
    )
